text:
maya (pm): Quick sync 1: customers keep asking for a 'flex SLA' add-on: pay a small monthly fee to get prioritized routing during configured business hours. We need product/contract shape + pilot scope.

alej (sales): This could reduce churn for bigger SMBs. Ask: can we make hours configurable per-tenant? They want Mon-Fri 9-6 in their timezone.

dave (eng): Tech: tenant tag + time-window check + priority queue doable. Need token/accounting if we bill usage separately. Estimate 2 sprints for pilot.

tara (finance): Pricing sketch: $149/mo + optional burst pack. Must model incremental cost of priority handling. Also need per-customer VAT handling if regionals opt in.

liz (legal): Contract flags: define "prioritized routing" (not a hard latency SLA), carveouts for capacity stress, and change control for safety. I'll draft a short addendum.

sam (devex): SDK/UI: tenant setting UI + header override so apps can opt in server-side during business hours. Need quickstart and sample evals.

alej (sales): Pilot asks: 1) 30-day trial, 2) admin UI to set hours, 3) per-hour usage export. Customers want logs for audits.

dave (eng): We'll emit priority.events with tenant/hours/consumption. That should satisfy billing + audit. Ops will do a prioritized queue (no hard reserve).

tara (finance): Free trial OK for pilot. I'll run sensitivity on $149 + 100k burst credits and share Tue. Need token export to billing.

liz (legal): Also add data residency note if customers configure replicated pools. Will post redlines.

maya (pm): Proposed pilot: US-only, 3 customers, configurable business hours, 30-day trial, subscription + optional burst. Owners: maya (PM), dave (eng), alej (sales), tara (finance), liz (legal), sam (devex). Kickoff Wed 9am PT. Any vetoes?

sam (devex): I'll prepare quickstart and an eval harness to measure priority vs baseline quality/latency.

dave (eng): No veto. Confirm ETA 6 weeks to pilot start (includes ops provisioning).

alej (sales): I'll recruit pilots today.

tara (finance): Will share models by Tue.

liz (legal): Will post addendum redlines tomorrow.

maya (pm): Great 1, locking kickoff Wed 9am PT. Will publish MRD draft tonight.
